Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Gabbeh Inspired Wool Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Sand Multi
Colors: San Multi
Materials: 80% Wool 20% Cotton
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported Designed with classic Gabbeh inspiration, this rug blends traditional style with contemporary tones. It features a tribal pattern of neutral colors, accented with single tassels on each corner. Distinctive style with sturdy construction Flat weave. Made in India. Wool/cotton blend. Highly durable 4' x 6' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
